logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-02 HVAC decision brief: a five-stage decision flow starting from the trusted candidate table, through the two-gate qualification screen (quality at least 80, defects at most 5), the energy ranking with gaps of 41, 24 and 11 kWh above the 9 kWh minimum, a uniqueness audit of table records, and the P4 verdict. A small bar chart shows measured energies P4 9, P3 20, P2 33, P1 50 kWh on the shared duty basis, and a dashed side panel lists the open questions (defect regrade at the P4 ceiling, P2's +2 floor margin, missing cost, delivery and maintenance evidence, basis stability). Flat, editable vector style; every element maps to a statement in the report prose.
